title: Era of the Saptarshi Cycle
summary: Start of the Saptarshi era, a Hindu cycle of centuries based on two stars of the Great Bear.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-25. CFAH notes it falls halfway between Creation (4004 B.C.) and the Flood (2348 B.C.) in the Ussher-Jones chronology. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-25: Era of the Saptarshi Cycle: 3176 B.C."
chronologies.note: The Kollam Era (1176 B.C.) counts from the third Saptarshi cycle; CFAH-3 suspects the era may have been back-calculated.
